title: Dignited (2019): Export a Wikipedia page as a PDF

steps.quote: In the left sidebar, find the section labeled "**Print/export**." Under that section, click "**Download as PDF**" from the list.
steps.text: In the left sidebar, find the section labeled "Print/export." Under that section, click "Download as PDF" from the list.
steps.goal: A page offering to download the article as a PDF is shown
